summary_en: Full-year dividend per share raised to ¥70 from ¥60 (period-end only). Payout-ratio policy target 50%. Board approval 2026-06-29; subject to shareholder approval at November 2026 AGM. Prior-year (FY2025 Aug) included ¥60 ordinary plus ¥40 commemorative dividend.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: On 29 June 2026, the board of NAGAILEBEN Co., Ltd. approved an increase to the full-year dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending August 2026. The period-end dividend per share has been raised from ¥60 to ¥70. The company states that the increase reflects comprehensive consideration of current operating performance and financial condition, with the aim of enhancing returns to shareholders. The company maintains a basic policy of stable dividend continuity with a payout-ratio target of approximately 50%, and intends to sustain the raised dividend level going forward in line with sustained improvement in corporate value. The dividend increase requires shareholder approval at the ordinary general meeting scheduled for November 2026. The prior fiscal year (August 2025) included an ordinary dividend of ¥60 per share plus a commemorative dividend of ¥40 per share, totalling ¥100.
